xna-type.name: VertexContent
xna-type.summary: Provides methods and properties for maintaining the vertex data of a GeometryContent.
xna-type.remarks: This class combines a collection of arbitrarily named data channels with a list of position indices that reference the Positions collection of the parent MeshContent .

property.name: Channels
property.summary: Gets the list of named vertex data channels in the VertexContent.

property.name: PositionIndices
property.summary: Gets the list of position indices.
property.remarks: This list adds a level of indirection between the actual triangle indices and the Positions member of the parent. This indirection preserves the topological vertex identity in cases where a single vertex position is used by triangles that straddle a discontinuity in some other data channel. For example, the following code gets the position of the first vertex of the first triangle in a GeometryContent object: parent.Positions[Vertices.PositionIndices[Indices[0]]]

property.name: Positions
property.summary: Gets position data from the parent mesh object.
property.remarks: The collection returned from this call provides a virtualized view of the vertex positions for this batch. The collection uses the contents of the PositionIndices property to index into the parent Positions . This collection is read-only. If you need to modify any contained values, edit the PositionIndices or Positions members directly.

property.name: VertexCount
property.summary: Number of vertices for the content.

method.name: Add
method.summary: Appends a new vertex index to the end of the PositionIndices collection.

overload.summary: Appends a new vertex index to the end of the PositionIndices collection.

parameters.parameter: Index of the new entry. This can be added to the Indices member of the parent.

overload.returns: Index into the MeshContent.Positions member of the parent.

method.name: AddRange
method.summary: Appends multiple vertex indices to the end of the PositionIndices collection.

overload.summary: Appends multiple vertex indices to the end of the PositionIndices collection.

parameters.parameter: Index into the Positions member of the parent.

method.name: CreateVertexBuffer
method.summary: This method is available only when developing for Windows.

overload.summary: This method is available only when developing for Windows.

method.name: Insert
method.summary: Inserts a new vertex index to the PositionIndices collection.

overload.summary: Inserts a new vertex index to the PositionIndices collection.

parameters.parameter: Position of new vertex index in the collection.

method.name: InsertRange
method.summary: Inserts multiple vertex indices to the PositionIndices collection.

overload.summary: Inserts multiple vertex indices to the PositionIndices collection.

parameters.parameter: Position of the first element of the inserted range in the collection.

method.name: RemoveAt
method.summary: Removes a vertex index from the specified location in both PositionIndices and VertexChannel<T>.

overload.summary: Removes a vertex index from the specified location in both PositionIndices and VertexChannel<T>.

parameters.parameter: Index of the vertex to be removed.

method.name: RemoveRange
method.summary: Removes a range of vertex indices from the specified location in both PositionIndices and VertexChannel<T>.

overload.summary: Removes a range of vertex indices from the specified location in both PositionIndices and VertexChannel<T>.

parameters.parameter: Index of the first vertex index to be removed.
